overview.text: Today's landscape features critical security updates, new model releases, and advances in visual perception and agentic systems. OpenAI has detailed strengthened containment protocols for frontier model training and evaluation, encompassing offline environments and high-compute red-teaming. Concurrently, Anthropic highlighted its work on critical infrastructure defense and cyber competitions. In model releases, Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed have captured significant community attention. Research advancements include FilmFlow, an agentic system designed for 3D virtual film cinematography to translate complex camera motion into executable trajectories, and WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), which unifies object-level and pixel-level perception via structured next-token prediction to address fine-grained visual perception limitations in vision-language models. Additionally, new investigations examine artifact detection in synthetic videos and trace the provenance of reasoning behavior in models.

entries.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
entries.summary: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.
entries.why: Provides crucial technical insights into securing frontier model training environments against emerging security threats.

entries.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed

entries.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
entries.summary: Complex camera motion is central to visual storytelling, yet translating cinematographic intent into controllable, executable camera trajectories remains challenging.
entries.why: Offers an agentic system approach for translating complex cinematographic intent into controllable 3D camera trajectories.

entries.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
entries.summary: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection.
entries.why: Addresses the growing need for reliable artifact detection in increasingly realistic AI-generated videos.

entries.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
entries.summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets.
entries.why: Introduces resource-linear budget control for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under strict resource constraints.

entries.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
entries.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction.
entries.why: Unifies object-level and pixel-level perception to improve fine-grained visual perception in vision-language models.

entries.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
entries.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data.
entries.why: Analyzes the distinction between reinforcement learning discoveries and inherited training data characteristics in reasoning models.
